name: ChromaClean Denoise (Bayer)

licence.name: MIT OR Apache-2.0
licence.notice: ChromaClean denoise model. Weights licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. Trained on 25267 quality-checked low-ISO crops: the author's own Sony A7 IV and Olympus E-M10 IV raws (9206 crops), CC0 raws from raw.pixls.us (12328 crops, many cameras; contributors credited in credits/raw_pixls_us_cc0.csv of the source repository), and 3733 crops from the Cube++ dataset (CC BY 4.0: E. Ershov et al., "The Cube++ Illumination Estimation Dataset", IEEE Access 2020, https://zenodo.org/records/4153431), with synthetic sensor noise calibrated on a Sony A7 IV and Olympus E-M10 IV (dark frames and flat fields, numbers only).

provenance: Trained with a 7.8 M-weight U-Net (upstream tools/denoise-train model.py) for 185000 steps on 25267 quality-checked low-ISO crops: the author's own Sony A7 IV and Olympus E-M10 IV raws (9206 crops), CC0 raws from raw.pixls.us (12328 crops, many cameras; contributors credited in credits/raw_pixls_us_cc0.csv of the source repository), and 3733 crops from the Cube++ dataset (CC BY 4.0: E. Ershov et al., "The Cube++ Illumination Estimation Dataset", IEEE Access 2020, https://zenodo.org/records/4153431); Poisson-Gaussian noise with row banding, calibrated on a Sony A7 IV; validated on real A7 IV and E-M10 IV ISO 200-25600 frames not used in training.
